name: City Council Special Meeting
agenda_text:
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETINGS

To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to
take place at City Hall, 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA at 9:00 a.m. on
Saturday, May 11, 2019. The agenda for the special meeting with the items of business to be
transacted or discussed is set forth below.
Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on May 3, 2019 at 5:00 p.m.
  May 11, 2019
  9:00 a.m.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to
on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If
applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office during normal business
hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is
requested to fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The
card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of
items shown on the agenda.

CITY COUNCIL - SPECIAL MEETING
MAY 11, 2019
  1
 NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R19-13

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O19-737

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

NEW BUSINESS

  1. Treasurer Interviews: Deliberation and Selection to fill the unexpired term of City Treasurer,
  expiring November 2020.

  2. Commission & Committee Interviews: Deliberation and Selection to fill 2 vacancies on the
  Planning Commission, 3 vacancies on the Parklands Committee, 3 vacancies on the Traffic
  Safety Committee, 3 vacancies on the Finance Advisory Committee, 2 vacancies on the
  Technology Advisory Committee, and 2 vacancies on the Law Enforcement Services
  Special Tax Oversight Committee.

ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY MAY 14, 2019, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL
CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing
agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to
Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos
Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in
accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 3rd day of May, 2019.
  Lauren Pettit, City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL - SPECIAL MEETING
MAY 11, 2019
